channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Aliados criticam falta de diálogo e participação de Flávio para resolver impasses no Rio e em Minas
item.description: Allies criticize Flávio Bolsonaro for lack of dialogue and slowness in political negotiations, particularly in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais, key states for his candidacy. He is accused of delaying important decisions and resisting agreements made by local leaders, causing dissatisfaction even within the PL and the União-PP federation.

item.title: Athletico-PR não vence o Corinthians como visitante desde 2009
item.description: Athletico-PR has not defeated Corinthians as an away team since 2009, with 15 matches resulting in eight losses and seven draws. In Thursday's (30/7) 21st round Brasileirão match at Neo Química Arena, the Furacão aims to end this streak, as Corinthians has never lost to them at home. Athletico-PR sits third with 36 points, Corinthians ninth with 28, both vying for top-table positions in the 2026 season.

item.title: Em meio a "distância segura", Flávio deve ir a convenção de Tarcísio
item.description: Despite allies of Tarcísio de Freitas intending to maintain a 'safe distance' from Flávio Bolsonaro during the electoral campaign, the senator is expected to attend the Republicanos state convention in São Paulo on Saturday (August 1), which will formalize the governor's re-election candidacy. Flávio's participation was confirmed by his pre-campaign team, although Tarcísio's team has not yet officially confirmed his attendance.

item.title: Congresso aprova posse do novo presidente da Colômbia fora da capital
item.description: Colombia's president-elect, Abelardo de la Espriella, will be sworn in on August 7 in Cali, after Congress approved the temporary transfer of presidential functions to the city. The measure passed with 58 votes in favor and 30 against in the Senate, following prior approval in the Chamber of Representatives. Despite opposition from the leftist bloc, which cites added costs and plans protests, the inauguration will take place in a university auditorium, as the use of a military barracks was denied by current President Gustavo Petro, who does not recognize the election results.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro desiste de vaga como suplente de André do Prado
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro withdrew his candidacy as a substitute for André do Prado in the 2026 Senate race after being declared ineligible by the STF for obstruction of justice. He has been self-exiled in the U.S. since February 2025, where he obtained a green card in July 2026, but claims he intends to return to Brazil when conditions allow. His withdrawal leaves the substitute positions to Fernando Fiori de Godoy and Rute Costa, both from PL-SP.

item.title: Alckmin declara “lealdade” a Lula e critica bolsonarismo
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) declared loyalty to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) during the PSB national convention in Brasília, where he was formalized as the re-election candidate on Lula’s ticket. He criticized Jair Bolsonaro’s (PL) government for using state apparatus to hinder voting in the 2022 election runoff, promoting hatred in the name of God, and mishandling the COVID-19 pandemic that caused around 700,000 deaths in Brazil. Alckmin defended democracy as the guardian of freedom and highlighted Lula’s administration’s achievements in employment, income, health, education, and housing.

item.title: Aliados de João veem que Raquel atingiu teto e vão nacionalizar disputa
item.description: Allies of João Campos, the PSB’s pre-candidate for governor of Pernambuco, believe Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) has reached her ceiling in voter intention polls, with the race currently balanced but slightly in her favor. They expect the dynamics to shift after August 16, when the campaign 'gets real,' and plan to nationalize the race by linking Lyra to Bolsonarism while emphasizing Campos’s record as mayor of Recife. They also dismissed Senate pre-candidate Túlio Gadêlha as politically insignificant for trying to align with Lula’s image.

item.title: Big techs terão de apresentar algoritmo que usam para o TSE
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques signed an ordinance requiring digital platforms with over 5 million users to submit a 'compliance plan' by August 16, 2026, detailing how they combat disinformation through AI controls, content moderation, bot detection, and transparency in paid advertising. The plan must grant the TSE access to algorithmic information while protecting commercial secrets, and may be overseen by an intensive monitoring committee comprising platform representatives, academics, and regulators.

item.title: João Campos diz que Lula vai a PE no 1º turno e frustra Raquel
item.description: João Campos, the PSB's pre-candidate for governor of Pernambuco, announced that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will visit the state in the first round of the 2026 elections, frustrating the expectations of Raquel Lyra's campaign, which had hoped for an agreement with Rui Costa to prevent Lula from appearing on the opposition's slate. Campos emphasized that the Lula-Alckmin alliance remains intact and projected victory based on his legacy as mayor of Recife, while also aiming to double the PSB's federal deputies in Congress.

item.title: “Vamos tomar um café”, diz Lula a Moraes após evento no Palácio do Planalto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva invited Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for coffee after an event at the Palácio do Planalto, a moment captured by event microphones. The meeting took place following the signing of the 'Pix Alimony Payment' law and days after Argentine President Javier Milei publicly insulted Lula as a 'convict' and Moraes as 'bald trash' during Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign launch. Brazil responded by summoning Argentina’s ambassador for explanations and recalling its own ambassador from Buenos Aires for consultations.

item.title: Nunes Marques pode criar o deepfake do bem
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques has been assigned a PT lawsuit against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over the use of AI in a PL party convention, and must now decide whether to uphold the current ban on deepfakes in campaigns or authorize their use in the 2026 elections, endorsing the Bolsonaro campaign's arguments. The ruling could set a precedent on the ethical or political use of artificial intelligence in Brazilian electoral disputes.

item.title: Lula diz que não perderá eleição mesmo se só errar com Alckmin
item.description: The PSB unanimously approved a coalition with the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV and PC do B) and confirmed Geraldo Alckmin as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula's ticket for the 2026 elections. Lula expressed confidence in winning the first round, even if they make mistakes, and urged activists to use their phones 24/7 to promote government actions and counter what he called a 'narrative war'.

item.title: Eduardo encontra Netanyahu em reunião de líderes evangélicos nos EUA
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at Blair House, the official residence for honored guests of U.S. presidents, during a meeting of evangelical leaders in the United States. He described the encounter as an 'honor,' recalling that his father, Jair Bolsonaro, had also stayed there during his first official visit to the U.S. in March 2019, and reiterated his belief in the alignment between Brazil, the U.S., and Israel as major democracies. The discussion also covered the health of former President Jair Bolsonaro and the 2026 presidential candidacy of his brother, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula chama Milei de “coisa” e diz que não quer Trump como inimigo
item.description: Lula da Silva dismissed Javier Milei's criticisms as 'nonsense' and called him a 'thing', stressing he maintains a state-to-state relationship with Argentina. He also said he does not seek conflict with Donald Trump, preferring to defeat him in the narrative, and noted Brazil denied visas to two U.S. citizens allegedly sent to interfere in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Durigan discute com Lula aperto no arcabouço em 4º mandato e novos gatilhos para restringir despesas
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan is discussing with President Lula a proposal to tighten the fiscal rule framework ahead of a potential fourth term, reducing the annual spending growth cap from the current 2.5% to 1.5%. The measure aims to curb public spending growth and ensure long-term fiscal sustainability.

item.title: Lula confirma Geraldo Alckmin como vice na chapa pela reeleição à Presidência
item.description: President Lula (PT) confirmed Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) as his running mate for re-election during the PSB national convention in Brasília. The ticket will be formalized on August 2 at the PT national convention in São Paulo. Lula praised Alckmin’s loyalty and honesty, criticized Bolsonaro’s handling of the pandemic, and stated he aims to defeat external figures like Trump and Milei through a 'narrative war'.

item.title: Vitória tem dois expulsos em menos de 2 minutos contra o Palmeiras
item.description: In the Vitória vs Palmeiras match of the 20th round of the Brasileirão, Vitória saw two players sent off in under two minutes: defender Cacá was shown a red card at 37' for a foul on Jhon Arias, confirmed by VAR, followed immediately by Luan Cândido for making a robbery gesture with his hands. Palmeiras scored through Maurício at 43' and extended the lead with an own goal by Fabiano Souza, while Flamengo's draw with Internacional left Palmeiras in sole leadership if they hold the win.

item.title: Negociações para advogado de Cid defender Vorcaro são encerradas
item.description: Negotiations for lawyer Cézar Bitencourt, who led Mauro Cid’s plea deal, to defend businessman Daniel Vorcaro were terminated without agreement. Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master and held in preventive detention by order of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, remains represented by Sérgio Leonardo and his law firm. The talks took place at Papudinha but stalled due to the prior rejection of plea deals by the PF and PGR, which were deemed lacking in new evidence.

item.title: Lula adota discurso de que vinho envelhecido é vinho bom para pedir voto
item.description: Lula employs the metaphor of aged wine to claim his experience and legacy make him a superior candidate in 2026, contrasting with Flávio Bolsonaro's youth. Although polls favor him, he acknowledges high rejection rates and the need to go beyond past achievements to win, given voter dissatisfaction with economic issues.

item.title: Bolsonaro, Flávio, Moraes e Alice no País das Maravilhas, by Vivendas
item.description: The article examines the use of AI to generate a video featuring Jair Bolsonaro’s image and voice, deployed at the PL convention, which violates precautionary measures ordered by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Although Bolsonaro is under house arrest, his defense claims he did not authorize the video, implying his son Flavio Bolsonaro acted without his knowledge. The piece criticizes the use of technology to circumvent judicial rulings and underscores the absurdity of the situation, likening it to the nonsensical logic in 'Alice in Wonderland'.

item.title: O novo ‘nós contra eles’ de Lula agora inclui Trump e Milei
item.description: Lula revives his 'us vs them' campaign strategy, now framing Donald Trump and Javier Milei as foreign actors interfering in Brazil’s election to support Flávio Bolsonaro, positioning himself as defender of national sovereignty. The narrative was reinforced during the PSB’s confirmation of Geraldo Alckmin as vice-presidential candidate, where allies emphasized patriotism, family, faith and democracy to contrast with the opposition’s alleged violent and anti-national agenda. The goal is to broaden a sense of national unity against external forces perceived as trying to sway the election in favor of the right.

item.title: 'Ninguém vai meter o bedelho nas eleições', diz Lula ao criticar ações dos EUA e da Argentina
item.description: President Lula criticized actions by the United States and Argentina, stating that no country will 'meddle' in Brazil's 2026 elections. He directed specific remarks at Donald Trump and Javier Milei, defending national sovereignty in the electoral process. The statement was made during a press conference on Wednesday, July 29, 2026.

item.title: “Não quero Trump como inimigo”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula (PT) said during the PSB national convention that he does not want to have Donald Trump as an enemy, emphasizing U.S. military power and advocating for a debate in the realm of ideas. He also commented on his relationship with Argentine President Javier Milei in the same international politics context.

item.title: Quilombo nos Parlamentos, que reúne 150 pré-candidatos negros, é lançado em São Paulo
item.description: The Black Coalition for Rights launched Quilombo nos Parlamentos 2026, uniting 150 Black pre-candidates to combat the underrepresentation of Black and mixed-race Brazilians in politics. The initiative aims to strengthen Black presence in municipal, state, and federal elections in 2026.

item.title: Lula diz que não briga com Trump ‘nem a porrete’ e que Milei fez ‘pataquada’ no Brasil
item.description: Lula stated he will not allow foreign interference in Brazilian elections and said he does not want to fight with Donald Trump, despite provocations. He criticized Argentine President Javier Milei for making a 'blunder' by attacking his government and STF ministers, but said he refrained from responding out of respect for the office of head of state. Lula also praised Geraldo Alckmin as a loyal and capable vice-president, asserting there is no risk of a coup with him on the ticket.

item.title: Moro aponta “grande absurdo ilegal” no caso de Bolsonaro
item.description: Former judge Sergio Moro (PL-PR), pre-candidate for governor of Parana, called the STF minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision granting Jair Bolsonaro 48 hours to explain the use of his image and voice in a video a "great illegal absurdity." Moro criticized the measure as arbitrary and offensive to due process.

item.title: Lula chama falas de Milei em convenção do PL de 'patacoada'
item.description: Lula criticized Javier Milei's remarks at the PL convention, calling them 'patacoada' (a slip for 'papaguada'), and defended a diplomatic stance despite Milei's personal attacks, in which he called Lula a 'convict' and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash'. Lula emphasized he avoids personal feuds, prefers state-to-state relations, and chooses peace and love over hostility.

item.title: TSE exige plano de big techs para combater desinformação com IA
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques signed an ordinance requiring digital platforms with over 5 million users to submit a 'compliance plan' to counter disinformation in the 2026 elections. The plan must detail how big techs will identify and label AI-generated content, ensuring electoral neutrality and preventing systems like ChatGPT from favoring candidates or parties. The measure aims to prevent AI from influencing votes in a partisan manner.

item.title: Lula: ‘Com Alckmin de vice, nunca vamos dormir e ter um golpe pela manhã’
item.description: Lula praised Vice President Geraldo Alckmin as a guarantee of loyalty and honesty, stating that his presence eliminates the possibility of a coup. He also criticized Bolsonaro, calling him a 'homicide' due to over 700,000 pandemic deaths, and reiterated the support of a left and center-left coalition for his reelection bid.

item.title: Lula chama Bolsonaro de 'homicida' em convenção do PSB que oficializou Alckmin como vice
item.description: Lula called Bolsonaro a 'homicida' during the pandemic, stating he was responsible for more than half of Brazil's COVID-19 deaths due to his handling of the health crisis. The remarks were made at the PSB national convention, which formalized the party's support for Lula's re-election and Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate. Alckmin praised Lula's loyalty and honesty and condemned extremists who undermine democracy and invoke God's name in vain.

item.title: Lula chama Bolsonaro de “homicida” e exalta Alckmin: “Com ele não vai ter golpe”
item.description: President Lula called former President Jair Bolsonaro a 'homicide' due to deaths during the COVID-19 pandemic and praised Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, stating that with him there will be no coup. The remarks were made at the PSB national convention.

item.title: TRE-SP multa Lula por propaganda eleitoral antecipada; cabe recurso
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) fined President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva R$15,000 for premature electoral campaigning, following a May 19 event where he allegedly solicited votes for Simone Tebet and Marina Silva. The judge ruled the statement contained an unequivocal request for electoral support, despite Lula’s defense claiming it was institutional in nature. An appeal is permitted.

item.title: PSB oficializa candidatura de Alckmin à Vice-Presidência da República
item.description: The Brazilian Socialist Party (PSB) officially endorsed Geraldo Alckmin as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula's ticket, confirming PT's support for the president's reelection. Alckmin, a physician and former governor of São Paulo, joined the PSB in 2022 and was elected vice president on the same ticket in 2022. The PT's national convention is expected to formally confirm Lula's candidacy on Sunday, August 2.

item.title: Crise com Milei: Após reunião com Vieira e Lula, embaixador do Brasil na Argentina voltará ao País
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, will return to Brazil after meeting with Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira and President Lula, following orders to 'close the case' on Argentine President Javier Milei's insults, in which he called Lula a 'prisoner' and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash'. Despite the provocations, expressions of solidarity toward Brazil emerged in Argentina, including from the Argentine Municipalities Federation, which labeled Milei's remarks an 'unacceptable lack of respect' and warned of risks to bilateral trade relations.

item.title: Haddad aposta em propostas para reduzir vantagem de Tarcísio
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that the race is 'stable' with a roughly 10-point deficit to Tarcísio de Freitas, and aims to close the gap through policy proposals. He emphasized the launch of the Quilombo in Parliament Manifesto, focused on combating racial quota frauds, political violence based on race and gender, and ensuring proportional allocation of electoral resources to Black candidates. Polls from Paraná Pesquisa and Quaest show Tarcísio leading with 48.5%, enough to win in the first round, while Haddad trails at 35.1%.

item.title: Pesquisa: a disputa Lula x Flávio nos estados que somam mais de 50% do eleitorado do Brasil
item.description: In São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Paraná, Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula in the first round, while in Bahia and Minas Gerais the president is ahead, with a numerical edge in Minas and clear lead in Bahia. Together, these five states account for 52.45% of the national electorate, making them decisive for the 2026 election. The Quaest surveys, conducted between July 22 and 27, show Lula performing better in second-round scenarios against Bolsonaro in Minas Gerais and Bahia, while Bolsonaro maintains an advantage in the three largest colleges of the Southeast and South.

item.title: Embaixador brasileiro na Argentina se reúne com Lula e ficará no Brasil por tempo indeterminado
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, was summoned to Brasília for consultations after Argentine President Javier Milei made offensive remarks against Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The Brazilian government has decided to keep Bitelli in Brazil indefinitely while assessing the bilateral relationship, awaiting signs of reconciliation from Argentina. The embassy in Buenos Aires is currently being led by a chargé d'affaires.

item.title: Luciana Santos chora em homenagem ao marido na convenção do PSB
item.description: Minister of Science and Technology Luciana Santos (PC do B) cried during the PSB National Convention in Brasília while honoring her late husband, state deputy Waldemar Borges (PSB-PE), who died on July 10 at age 67. The emotional tribute highlighted his political legacy in Pernambuco.

item.title: Governo Lula rebate EUA após prorrogação de estado de emergência
item.description: The Lula government denounced as 'baseless' and 'unfounded' the U.S. extension of a national emergency against Brazil, arguing that accusations of Brazil posing an unusual threat to U.S. security lack factual basis and ignore Brazil’s sovereignty and long-standing diplomatic friendship.

item.title: Para alguns dos maiores grupos políticos, serve qualquer presidente da República
item.description: Brazil’s major parties, including MDB and PSD, have adopted a neutral stance in the 2026 presidential elections, prioritizing congressional seat gains over endorsing a specific candidate. This strategy, driven by high polarization and control over parliamentary amendments, allows regional directories to support any candidate — from Lula to Caiado or Flávio — based on local convenience. The Supreme Court, led by Minister Flávio Dino, is pushing back by demanding a 'responsibility plan' for mandatory amendments and threatening to declare them unconstitutional, risking civil disobedience from entrenched party bosses linked to scandals like Master.

item.title: Alckmin é confirmado como vice e vai reeditar chapa vitoriosa de Lula
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin has been officially confirmed as the vice-presidential candidate on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's ticket for the 2026 elections, recreating the winning alliance from 2022. The confirmation was made at a PSB event in Brasília on July 29, 2026, following Lula’s earlier announcement in a ministerial meeting on March 31. The ticket aims to defeat Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and if elected, Lula would become Brazil’s oldest president and the first to serve a fourth term.

item.title: Geraldo Alckmin venceu a desconfiança de petistas e se consolidou como 'companheiro' de Lula, de quem foi rival em 2006
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin, former rival of Lula in 2006 and former PSDB leader, has been confirmed as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula’s re-election ticket for 2026. The PSB officially nominated him at a national convention, following Lula’s March announcement that the 'Lula with chuchu' alliance would be renewed, dispelling PT rumors of a replacement. Alckmin, noted for his understated style and nickname 'chuchu popsicle', earned petista trust through his productive sector engagement, particularly in countering U.S. tariffs, becoming Lula’s trusted 'companion' in the third term.

item.title: Geraldo Alckmin é oficializado pelo PSB como candidato à vice-presidência na chapa de Lula à reeleição
item.description: The Brazilian Socialist Party (PSB) officially nominated Geraldo Alckmin as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula's re-election ticket for 2026, during a national convention in Brasília. The coalition includes the PT, PCdoB, PV, PDT, PSol, and Rede, replicating the winning alliance from 2022. Alckmin criticized the previous government, defending democracy as the guardian of liberty and stating that those who do not believe in the electoral process should not run for office.

item.title: Compra de votos? Lula usa Super El Niño para distribuir cestas básicas
item.description: The Lula government announced it will use the Super El Niño climate phenomenon to expand the distribution of basic food baskets ahead of the October elections. The measure was disclosed by Chief of Staff Miriam Belchior in a public meeting, sparking criticism that the government is attempting to buy votes by linking social aid to a climatic event.

item.title: Plataformas digitais devem enviar planos de conformidade ao TSE até 16 de agosto
item.description: The TSE has required digital platforms to submit compliance plans by August 16 for the 2026 electoral period, including commitments to monitor, remove content, combat gender-based political violence, and report coordinated inauthentic behavior. The measure aims to safeguard electoral integrity and already applies to cases such as the alleged network of fake accounts that reportedly boosted disinformation against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Ancelotti foca no meio-campo no processo de reconstrução da Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Brazil national team coach Carlo Ancelotti stated that finding high-level midfielders is a priority in rebuilding the team after the 2026 World Cup failure. He emphasized the need to strengthen the midfield to restore the team's competitiveness.

item.title: Tarcísio adia “free flow” na Imigrantes e anuncia reposicionamento
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas postponed the launch of the free-flow electronic toll system (Siga Fácil) on the Imigrantes Highway following protests from residents of São Bernardo do Campo. The northbound toll gantry was relocated from km 32 to km 38, while the southbound gantry remains at km 29 and the Anchieta Highway equipment stays at km 33. The current toll of R$ 40,60 in the coastal direction will remain until the new system is operational, at which point the fee will be split into R$ 20,30 for each direction of the mountain range.

item.title: Após eliminação nas oitavas, Ancelotti revisita lista de convocados: "Correta"
item.description: Coach Carlo Ancelotti defended Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad selection, stating that despite injuries and limited preparation time, the final list was correct. He noted that surprise inclusions like Weverton, Neymar, Endrick, and Rayan had few appearances under him before the final roster. Ancelotti also confirmed he kept Neymar in the squad despite a recent injury, while omitting João Pedro, who had been named Chelsea's best player of the season.

item.title: Em meio a novo ataque às urnas, TSE diz quais empresas fabricam os aparelhos
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) disclosed that Brazil's electronic voting machines are manufactured exclusively by four Brazilian companies: Positivo Tecnologia, Diebold, Unisys Brasil, and Procomp Indústria Eletrônica, refuting claims that they are made by Venezuelan firm Smartmatic. The TSE emphasizes that the machines undergo rigorous security testing at least one year before elections and are not commercially available, being produced under exclusive bidding by the Electoral Justice. Statements by Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, and Jair Bolsonaro alleging fraud in the voting system are false and part of a growing conspiracy narrative ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio deu aval à negativa ao STF sobre vídeo de Bolsonaro com IA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, acting as legal counsel for former President Jair Bolsonaro, told the STF that the AI-generated video shown at the PL convention — in which Bolsonaro appears to endorse his son’s candidacy — was not authorized by the former president due to judicial restrictions preventing communication between them. The defense argues that the visitation ban and contact prohibition make prior consent impossible, and that the video’s dissemination constitutes a potential violation of house arrest conditions.
